coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No standalone Irish scrap metal dealer register. Duty is a 2014 amendment to the Waste Management (Facility Permit and Registration) Regulations 2007: permitted facilities buying metal must record supplier ID and address, vehicle registration and collection permit number, material, weight, amount paid, and get a signed ownership statement (Oireachtas PQ 2018-05-29). Candidate C-scrap (weak, unverified). Close to K08 but a different duty.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnbrokers: only 3 licensed (CCPC, Pawnbrokers Act 1964), too few. No Garda second-hand dealer register found (only the General Dealers (Ireland) Act 1903, likely obsolete). Dealers fall under the AML high value goods dealer regime, see candidate.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Hallmarking is compulsory via the Dublin Assay Office (makers, not buyers). Jewellers are high value goods dealers supervised by the AMLCU (about 2,000 businesses in 2014). See AML candidate.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: ELV Regulations 2014 (SI 281/2014, amended 2016, 2020, 2023): authorised treatment facilities are authorised by councils and issue Certificates of Destruction via the ELVES compliance scheme. No 2026 trigger found. Weak candidate. Dismantler vs ATF status unclear.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K23 and K15. Not searched further.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Small plants are approved and supervised by local authority vets under FSAI procedures. Abattoirs Act 1988 requires slaughter records kept 3 years. FSAI earlier found only about 27% of 961 high-risk butchers compliant. No HACCP software vendor found in the results. Weak candidate.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Beekeepers register with DAFM as food business operators (free). No mandatory apiary or hive register for the Republic. AFB, EFB, small hive beetle and Tropilaelaps are notifiable (SI 308/2013). Very small volume. Nothing to build.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: VCI Premises Accreditation Scheme Regulations 2026 in force from 1 Jan 2026 (Certificate of Suitability). The VMP, Medicated Feed and Fertilisers Regulation Act 2023 adds retailer licences (s.18) and a Companion Animal Medicine Retailers' Register (s.21). Prescriptions are covered by K09. Two weak candidates.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Abstraction Act in force 28 Aug 2024. Registration with EPA (EDEN) for 25-1,999 m3/day; licence above 2,000 m3/day. Existing abstractors had until 28 Feb 2025. No driller-specific duty found. The one-off deadline has passed. Weak.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: DWWTS registration and inspection (Water Services (Amendment) Act 2012; EPA National Inspection Plan 2022-2026, at least 1,200 inspections a year; 56% of 1,390 failed in 2024; grant up to EUR 12,000). Buyers are households, not businesses. Waste hauler permit is K08 (rejected). Weak. A successor inspection plan after 2026 is unchecked.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifting equipment: SI 299/2007 requires periodic thorough examination by a competent person. Boiler and pressure rules and HSA notification were not confirmed. Mostly served by insurers' engineering inspectors (e.g. Munich Re HSB). Unverified.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: About 370 group water schemes serve 190,000 people; 1,665 small private supplies are registered and the total is unknown; EUR 38.5m of private-supply improvement funding went unused 2019-2023 (EPA, July 2024). Local authorities regulate. Operators are volunteer committees. Candidate, unverified.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02 and K22. Not searched further.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Employment Agency Act 1971: licence from the WRC via licences.ie at EUR 500 a year, with Garda vetting. No reform found (2005 proposal to move to registration never appeared to land). Weak.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Funeral directors are unregulated, no bill found. Burial grounds run under the 1888 rules (amended 2013) and council bye-laws; Meath published draft 2026 burial ground bye-laws. Community and parish cemeteries keep registers of interment. See candidate. Related to K04 but a different buyer.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Charities Act 2009 s.52: annual report due within 10 months of year end (31 Oct for calendar-year charities). About 40% filed late (Law Society Gazette, 2023). Governance Code compliance record form must be kept and updated yearly, and compliance is declared at filing. The regulator has a stricter enforcement stance. See candidate. Halal and kosher supervision not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: SPSV licensing by NTA (renewal needs NCT under 90 days and tax clearance; age limits 10 years, 15 for WAV; 2025 consultation on taxi maximum age regs). The NTA already sends reminders; odo.ie covers NCT and motor tax reminders. Road haulage operator licence is held by the Department of Transport (RTOL), over 3.5 t only; no new regime. Weak.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: No 'Street Trading Act 2024' exists in Ireland. Casual trading is under the Casual Trading Act 1995, with council-level licences and bye-laws (Leitrim draft 2026 bye-laws, comments closed 17 Jul 2026). No national reform found. Money changers not searched. Weak.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Childminders: Child Care Act 1991 (Early Years Services) (Childminding Services) Regulations 2024 (SI 494/2024), registration open since 30 Sep 2024, voluntary during a 3-year transition (to about autumn 2027, unconfirmed). Main candidate. Driving schools: RSA ADI register, no 2026 change confirmed. Pet sellers: SI 681/2019 register for 6+ animals a year. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters not searched.
